**STRIXEL-GBTS-PhysVal-03: zero unresolved material findings.** The documented prototype interpretation is supported at reviewed commit **`a9867564c4ebaeac774aa350e0f440f887916067`**. This was an independent read-only assessment under the explicit PhysVal fallback and review skill; no native profile loading or human acceptance is claimed.

The two PhysVal-02 findings are resolved: zero-discordance contrasts carry conservative finite-sample bounds and no equivalence claim; measurement-count deficits/excesses are explicitly distinguished from exhaustive hit losses/gains. The ROOT summary repair binds original serialized bytes, correctly handling the 44 JSON key-order round-trip differences without weakening numerical or classifier checks (`root_audit.py:112–126`).

Actual checks completed:

- Verified all **105 pinned objects**, including all **80 NPZs**, against their SHA-256 records and reviewed revision. Each case contains 1,000 event IDs and 79 arrays.
- Verified all **240 retained case artifacts**, all 80 original summary-byte bindings, common native source maps, configuration gates and native report hashes.
- Independently reconstructed **1,278,653 exact point values** across cases, regions and stages: counts, rates, residuals, pulls, widths, biases, tails, common-success ratios and pairing diagnostics. No discrepancy; no width was defined below 30 finite entries.
- Independently reproduced all 80 global Wilson intervals and 400-resample paired efficiency intervals, plus first-principles central 100 GeV muon z₀/θ width and ratio intervals.
- Ran the focused suite: **49 tests passed**.
- Ran `bridge.py … --verify`: **20 baseline bridges passed**, covering the 812 original observables and NaN masks.
- Verified all recorded ROOT case bindings/counts, totaling **5,406,814 covariance marginals**. Additionally re-ran the frozen ROOT auditor on three actual 100 GeV cases: **303,741 marginals**, complete event/raw-candidate counts and representative tuples passed, including the Geant4 electron case with 455,022 CKF candidates.
- Verified all **40 figure hashes**, checked all 20 PDFs are one page, and rendered/inspected four figure families. Interval endpoints, units and low-count handling are consistent with the source.
- Session validation passed for 217 records; summary completed.

The summary’s principal observations reproduce: central 100 GeV muon z₀ ratios at 2 mm are **1.106 in Fatras** and **1.151 in Geant4**. The same 254 Fatras and 267 Geant4 matched central events supply every pitch. Endpoint all-generated efficiency changes span **0 to +3.6 percentage points**. The stated high-momentum charge and momentum tails also reproduce.

The interpretation remains appropriately bounded: non-target realized inputs change in **12–167 events per group** at 2 mm, including two central muon events per transport. Consequently these results cannot establish uniquely longitudinal causation. Intervals are pointwise and statistical; sparse-bin bootstrap coverage remains limited. The study establishes neither physical coarse-sensor calibration, statistical equivalence, occupancy performance nor detector acceptance.

Scientific inputs remain `4ea4af…`; native execution remains `8c451360…`; retained analysis SHA-256 is `503bd05a…`. Prior frozen helpers and retained baseline evidence are unchanged. I did not repeat the entire bootstrap/export campaign or all 80 raw ROOT audits; their bound records were checked, supplemented by the independent calculations above.

No canonical files changed, native jobs launched, commits created, publication performed or agents delegated. Only permitted ephemeral `/private/tmp` review scratch was created.
